objectives.statement: Convert direct statements into indirect speech with at and correct subordinate word order.
Choose natural tense shifts after past reporting verbs, including hadde and skulle.
Shift pronouns, time words, and place words according to the reporting situation.
Report yes-no questions, information questions, and commands using om, question words, and å-clauses.

notes: Must teach indirect speech with pronoun/deictic shifts, subordinate word order, tense shift where natural, and conversion of questions/imperatives into at/om/å-clauses. Include common shifts such as her->der, i morgen->dagen etter, and nå->da when context requires them.
